MAIL_TO.description: The email address to which apticron will send updates.

SMTP_SERVER.description: The SMTP server to use for sending emails.

MINIMAL_UPDATES.description: If set to true, only send email if there are security updates.

EMAIL_SUBJECT_PREFIX.description: Prefix for the subject line of the email.

EMAIL_FOOTER.description: Additional text to include at the bottom of the email.

LIST_ONLY_UPGRADES.description: If set to true, only list packages that can be upgraded.

SHOW_KERNES.description: If set to true, list kernel packages separately.

APT_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to a custom apt config file.

CRON_DAILY_RUN.description: Whether to run apticron via cron.daily.

NO_LIST.description: If set to true, do not list the packages in the email, just notify.
